sitiosSoloLectura: The account manages its sites and doors from the app. Here they are read-only.
sinSuscripcion: This account has no active subscription. Its doors reject access.

noEncontrada.texto: It may have been removed or the link may be wrong.

sitiosVacio.texto: The account creates them from the app.

venceHoy: Expires on {{fecha}}, today. After that, access is rejected with “Subscription expired”.
vencioEl: Expired on {{fecha}}, {{dias}} days ago. Access is rejected with “Subscription expired”.
suspendidaTexto: The subscription is suspended. Access is rejected until it is reactivated.
cambiarCodigoTexto: The first 3 letters of every user's PIN become the new code. The rest of the PIN stays the same and nobody gets a new PIN; they just type the new letters. Open sessions are not closed.
administradoresVacio: This account has no active administrators.
regenerarTexto: A new PIN is drawn and shown only once. The previous one stops working and their sessions are closed. The PINs of the other users are regenerated by each administrator from the app.
pinNuevoAviso: This PIN won't be shown again. Copy it and hand it to whoever manages the account.
eliminarTexto: Nobody in this account will be able to sign in again, neither to the app nor with their QR codes. Its data is kept for the audit log and accounting, and its code becomes free. This action can't be undone from the panel.
pendienteAviso: This account hasn't paid its first year yet: it issues no QR and opens no doors until the payment is recorded.
pendienteTexto: Pending its first payment: it starts operating once it is recorded.
sinResponsable: This account has no contact details.
